mco.pdp.trial.title: YOUR OWN SERVER, ALWAYS ONLINE
mco.pdp.trial.description:
Run your own Minecraft server! You set the rules: who can join and how to play. Members play for free, even when you're offline. Easy to set up, manage, and access from any computer.

What are Realms?
mco.pdp.friends.title: Persistent multiplayer worlds
mco.pdp.friends.description: Worlds uploaded to your Realm are always available to you and your invited Realm members - at any time, on any computer. Members can play even when you're away.
mco.pdp.minigames.title: Members play free
mco.pdp.minigames.description: People you invite become Realm members. They don't need to pay to join and play on the Realm; they just need a copy of Minecraft: Java Edition.
mco.pdp.private.title: Easy and safe
mco.pdp.private.backups: No need for technical know-how. Free, no-hassle backups. No sharing personal information.
